packages.technology_name: Multi-Segment Flow Control with Bayesian Occlusion Prediction
packages.problem: The prior generalized 30-50% obstruction-rate statement was inadequately qualified. Published studies report population- and study-specific obstruction proportions: a systematic review of 38,095 adult shunt surgeries (PubMed 37004137) found obstruction accounted for approximately 23.2% of adult shunt failures, while pediatric populations report higher proportions in some studies. Overall shunt failure rates are 40-50% at 1-2 years (PubMed 42490332), of which obstruction is one major cause but not the entirety. The exact obstruction fraction varies by patient population, study design, and follow-up duration. The dossier should cite population-specific sources rather than a universal rate.
packages.mechanism: Multi-segment parallel catheter with Bayesian occlusion prediction and alpha-distribution controller
packages.kill_if: Multi-segment shows no advantage over single-segment in >=80% of computational scenarios

packages.technology_name: Adaptive Valve Profile for Postural ICP Regulation
packages.problem: ICP excursions during postural changes cause patient symptoms
packages.mechanism: Valve whose opening pressure profile adapts to ICP trend via trend-feedback control
packages.kill_if: Adaptive response time exceeds postural transient duration (cannot respond within seconds)

packages.technology_name: Catalytic Contact Time Lock for Amyloid Beta Clearance
packages.problem: Amyloid beta accumulation in CSF of Alzheimer's/NPH patients with shunts
packages.mechanism: NEP enzyme immobilized on catheter wall cleaves A-beta-42 via mass-transport-limited contact time
packages.kill_if: Enzyme half-life in CSF environment is less than 30 days (insufficient for chronic implant)

packages.problem: The prior generalized 30-50% obstruction-rate statement was inadequately qualified. Published studies report population- and study-specific obstruction proportions: a systematic review of 38,095 adult shunt surgeries (PubMed 37004137) found obstruction accounted for approximately 23.2% of adult shunt failures, while pediatric populations report higher proportions in some studies. Overall shunt failure rates are 40-50% at 1-2 years (PubMed 42490332), of which obstruction is one major cause but not the entirety. The exact obstruction fraction varies by patient population, study design, and follow-up duration. The dossier should cite population-specific sources rather than a universal rate. with no passive safety floor
packages.mechanism: Multi-lumen parallel catheter with differential conductance maintaining minimum drainage when primary path obstructs
packages.kill_if: Common-cause obstruction affects both primary and floor lumens equally (no differential immunity)

packages.technology_name: Phage Anti-Biofilm Coating for Shunt Infection Prevention
packages.problem: Infection causes 8-12% of shunt failures at $40-80K per case
packages.mechanism: S. aureus phage K immobilized on electrospun titanium-coated catheter surface prevents biofilm establishment
packages.kill_if: Phage K cannot retain infectivity when immobilized on Ti surface for >24h

packages.problem: Shunt failure prediction is reactive (symptoms then surgery)
packages.mechanism: ML-based predictor using ICP and flow trends to forecast failure >=12h before symptoms
packages.kill_if: No real failure dataset exists to train the model (CRITICAL BLOCKER per Article XXXVII). This package is REPOSITIONED as a long-term research direction, not a near-term technology transfer opportunity. The technology is data-conditional — it cannot be developed without a prospective multi-year clinical dataset.

packages.technology_name: Self-Powered Sensing via Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting
packages.problem: Chronic ICP monitoring requires battery or percutaneous leads
packages.mechanism: Piezoelectric transducer harvests energy from CSF pulsation; duty-cycled sensing matches harvested power budget (R1 fix)
packages.kill_if: Harvested power at in-vivo strain levels is insufficient for any duty cycle (model shows <0.1 µW average)

packages.technology_name: NIR Photovoltaic Power Delivery for Implantable Devices
packages.problem: Implantable sensors need power without batteries or leads
packages.mechanism: External 940nm NIR source penetrates tissue; implanted GaAs PV cell converts to electrical energy
packages.kill_if: Tissue attenuation at 5cm depth prevents sufficient power delivery (>1mW/cm2 required at PV surface)

packages.technology_name: UWB Catheter Position Mapping with SAR-Bounded Accuracy
packages.problem: Catheter position verification requires CT/MRI (expensive, ionizing for CT)
packages.mechanism: UWB transmitter in catheter; external receiver array localizes via TOA with SAR-bounded accuracy (R1 fix)
packages.kill_if: SAR limit (1.6 W/kg) constrains transmit power below useful SNR at >5cm tissue depth

packages.problem: Catheter placement is operator-dependent; malposition causes complications
packages.mechanism: Hydraulic steering with closed-loop navigation; human-in-the-loop fallback (R1 fix); buckling analysis
packages.kill_if: Buckling threshold is below typical insertion forces (catheter cannot navigate without buckling)

packages.technology_name: Gravity Compensation Hydraulic Damper for Postural Transients
packages.problem: Postural ICP excursions cause over-drainage and under-drainage
packages.mechanism: Proportional hydraulic damper attenuates postural pressure transients continuously (vs ASD on/off switching)
packages.kill_if: Damper coefficient cannot be tuned to both attenuate transients AND maintain minimum drainage floor

packages.problem: Fixed-pressure valves cannot adapt to changing CSF conditions
packages.mechanism: Semipermeable membrane with osmotic reservoir provides self-regulating drainage based on combined hydrostatic and osmotic pressure
packages.kill_if: Membrane fouling rate in CSF reduces Lp by >50% within 30 days (insufficient for chronic implant)

packages.problem: Chronic ICP monitoring sensors suffer from drift
packages.mechanism: Piezoresistive MEMS sensor with self-referencing Wheatstone bridge for drift compensation (R1 fix)
packages.kill_if: Self-referencing cannot reduce drift below 1 mmHg/month (insufficient for clinical utility)

packages.technology_name: Acoustic Obstruction Detection for CSF Shunts
packages.problem: Shunt obstruction is detected late (symptoms then imaging)
packages.mechanism: Catheter-integrated acoustic transducer detects obstruction via pulse-echo impedance contrast
packages.kill_if: Tissue obstruction acoustic impedance is too similar to CSF for reliable detection (Z ratio < 1.1)

packages.technology_name: MR Flow Quantification Sensor at Catheter Scale
packages.problem: CSF flow measurement requires clinical MRI (expensive, not continuous)
packages.mechanism: Miniaturized permanent magnet + RF coil + gradient coil enables phase-contrast MRI flow measurement at catheter scale
packages.kill_if: Miniaturization to catheter scale cannot achieve SNR > 10:1 at any B0 field (physically blocked)
